instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete responsive multi-page web app matching the dark navy + champagne gold aesthetic from the provided user screenshots.
Use React Router for page navigation across 首页, 项目中心, 合作共赢, 关于我们, 联系我们, and Admin Message inbox.
Ensure contact submissions post to backend API /api/contact and persist to database, viewable via the admin inbox panel.
Add gold glow micro-interactions, particle floating hero background, smooth page transitions with framer-motion, and toast feedback with sonner.
Ensure all text content is in Simplified Chinese with accurate business language.
